incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: p99 latency > 1200ms for route inference.v1.generate in inference-prod-uswest. PagerDuty incident PD12345 created.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident PD12345 triggered. Auto-escalation scheduled in 15m.

alice: ack PD12345. jumping on metrics.

bob: grabbing traces now.

carla: looking at grafana: https://grafana.company/d/abcd/inference-overview — p99 jumped from ~300ms to ~1600ms in the last 8m. No 5xx spike.

dmitri: logs show tokenization timeouts & a lot of kv-cache misses on sidecar nodes. snippet:
```
2026-03-18T10:03:12Z sidecar token_fetch timeout=1200ms req_id=xyz
2026-03-18T10:03:34Z worker kv_cache miss hotkey=embed_user_42 latency=800ms
```

eva: is this region-only? checking EU/US-West split.

alice: confirmed US-WEST only, EU stable. Traffic shifted to hosted fallback around 10:02 which increased tail latency.

bob: suspect autoscaler scale-up lag + kV cache thrash. Plan: reduce batch size on sidecars as quick mitigation and add a 10-20% reroute to fallback pool.

carla: can you paste the exact command you will run?

bob: run:
```
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/sidecar BATCH_SIZE=4 --record
```

alice: applying to canary (10% nodes) now.

pagerduty-bot: PD12345 acknowledged by alice.

incident-bot: note: estimated affected sessions ~2.3% of active streaming sessions; no customer 5xx increase observed yet.

dmitri: creating temporary reroute: set route-policy inference-uswest fallback_weight=20%

eva: reroute applied. watching p99.

carla: canary p99 dropped to ~700ms after the batch-size change and reroute, looks promising.

alice: good. leaving reroute at 20% while autoscaler finishes warm-up. handoff: @frank is on-call lead in 25m.

bob: I'll keep monitoring logs for kv miss rate and sidecar latencies. plan to revert patch once p99 consistent under 500ms for 10m.

support-team: pinged #support to prepare a customer note; no public incident page yet.

oncall-sre: taking over monitoring for next 30m at 11:00. playbook items: monitor p99, keep reroute 10-20% until scale settled, collect traces for postmortem.

alice: acknowledged. Will post a short post-incident summary after stabilization. :memo:

carla: :thumbsup:
